query: select c.oid::regclass::text relation,a.attname column_name,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod) data_type,a.attnotnull not_null,a.attidentity identity,pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid) default_value,a.attacl::text column_acl from pg_attribute a join pg_class c on c.oid=a.attrelid join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace left join pg_attrdef d on d.adrelid=a.attrelid and d.adnum=a.attnum where n.nspname in ('public','finance_private') and c.relkind in ('r','p') and a.attnum>0 and not a.attisdropped order by relation,a.attnum;
